Name: (AT) Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Craftables
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
Replaces craftables with a rich burnt sienna and gold palette, akin to the chest you find in the mines. Now in Alternative Textures~
Huge thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/68147882-angelofstars/]AngelOfStars[/url]﻿ for the AT conversion!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1877]For the Content Patcher version, go here![/url]﻿

[b]NOTES:[/b]
- Chests do not change color due to AT limitations.
- The campfire and cookout-kit are categorized as the same thing, so you can use the cookout kit and the campfire texture on both objects-- so you can make your campfires look like cookout kits, and vice versa.

This mod affects the following items:
Anvil, Auto-Grabber, Auto-Petter, Bait Maker, Bee House, Bone Mill, Barrel Brazier, Stump Brazier, Carved Brazier, Wooden Brazier, Campfire, Cask, Charcoal Kiln, Cheese Press, Chest, Big Chest, Stone Chest, Big Stone Chest, Coffee Maker, Cookout Kit, Crystalarium, Dehydrator, Farm Computer, Fish Smoker, Furnace, Heavy Furnace, Garden Pots, Geode Crusher, Hopper, Jukebox, Keg, Wood Lamp, Iron Lamp, Lightning Rod, Loom, Mayo Maker, Mini Obelisk, Mini Shipping Bin, Mushroom Box, Mushroom Log, Oil Maker, Ostrich Incubator, Preserves Jar, Recycling Machine, Seed Maker, Sewing Machine, Wood Sign, Stone Sign, Text Sign, Solar Panel, Statue of Blessings, Statue of the Dwarf King, Tapper, Heavy Tapper, Tub 'o Flowers, Wood Chipper, Worm Bin, Deluxe Worm Bin, and Workbench.

Any more items you'd like to see with this color palette? Leave a comment on this mod, or send me a DM and I'll make an update!

To install--
1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy! Use the Paint Bucket to apply your chosen colors-- see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures'[/url]﻿ instructions for further details.
